findings.title: Uses inline SurfaceState for a page-level gate
findings.detail: OrganizationShellState now renders SurfaceState inside a bare main. The shared helper explicitly defines SurfaceState as an inline panel and PageGate as the page-level counterpart for OrganizationWorkspaceShellPage shell states. This changes the route-level loading, unauthorized, and invalid-state structure and leaves the existing organization-shell-state page styling/selectors mismatched with the new nested DOM; use the page-level gate contract while preserving the three state branches.

checks.result: pass; no browser or release proof claimed

residual_risks: Content-state operation guards, organization/Lark authority checks, ownership and campaign accent attributes, and responsive primitive breakpoints were reviewed statically; runtime behavior was not executed.
